description: The REST API itself (plan.md items 7-12): error envelope, OpenAPI builder over z.toJSONSchema, the registered Zod schemas, response serializers, the endpoint() handler wrapper, 29 endpoint definitions and their 21 route files under src/routes/api/v1, the public /api/v1/openapi.json, a [...path] catch-all returning the envelope, and the tests proving the spec is valid and covers every route. Every handler calls existing services (extended in FEAT-001); no business logic in routes. Depends on FEAT-001 (ServiceError.kind, guard, new services). FEAT-003 depends on it (openApiDocument, ERROR_CODES).
steps: Read the 'Endpoints' table and 'Design decisions' 1-14 in c:\Users\patrik.pavic\Desktop\tournament2\tournament\.agents\tasks\m7-rest-api\plan.md: it fixes every operationId, method, path, body/query, service call, success status and documented conflicts.

New src/lib/server/api/errors.ts (pure: zod, '@sveltejs/kit' json/isHttpError, ServiceError): `export const ERROR_CODES = { 400: 'invalid_request', 401: 'unauthorized', 404: 'not_found', 405: 'method_not_allowed', 409: 'conflict', 422: 'unprocessable', 500: 'internal_error' } as const;` `export const errorSchema = z.object({ error: z.object({ code: z.enum(Object.values(ERROR_CODES)), message: z.string(), issues: z.array(z.object({ path: z.array(z.union([z.string(), z.number()])), message: z.string() })).optional().describe('What is wrong with each part of the request.') }) }).describe('Every error has this shape.');` `apiError(status: number, message: string, issues?)`: maps unknown statuses to 400 (4xx) or 500, returns json({ error: { code, message, ...(issues && { issues }) } }, { status, headers: status === 401 ? { 'www-authenticate': 'Bearer' } : undefined }) typed with z.input<typeof errorSchema>. `errorResponse(e: unknown)`: z.ZodError -> apiError(400, issues[0].message, issues mapped { path: path.map(p => typeof p === 'symbol' ? String(p) : p), message }); ServiceError -> { conflict: 409, invalid: 422, not_found: 404 }[e.kind] with e.message; isHttpError(e) -> apiError(e.status, e.body.message); else console.error(e) and apiError(500, 'Something went wrong.'). Doc comments in the repo's tone.

New src/lib/server/api/errors.spec.ts (server project, pure): ZodError from a small schema -> 400 invalid_request with issues paths; ServiceError default/invalid/not_found -> 409 conflict / 422 unprocessable / 404 not_found; error(401, 'x') caught -> 401 unauthorized with www-authenticate: Bearer; error(404) -> 404; new Error('boom') -> 500 internal_error (vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {})); every body parses with errorSchema.

New src/lib/server/api/openapi.ts (pure; imports zod and './errors' only): `export type Method = 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'`; `export const TAGS = [{ name: 'Tournaments', description }, { name: 'Lifecycle', … }, { name: 'Stages', … }, { name: 'Participants', … }, { name: 'Matches', … }, { name: 'Messages', … }] as const` and `export type Tag = (typeof TAGS)[number]['name']`; `export interface Endpoint { operationId: string; method: Method; /** Relative to `/api/v1`, with `{param}` placeholders. */ path: string; tag: Tag; summary: string; description?: string; params?: z.ZodObject; query?: z.ZodObject; body?: z.ZodType; response: { status: 200 | 201; description: string; schema: z.ZodType } | { status: 204; description: string }; /** Rule violations it can answer with, besides 400/401/404. */ conflicts?: readonly (409 | 422)[] }`; `export const defineEndpoint = <const E extends Endpoint>(endpoint: E) => endpoint;`. `export function buildOpenApiDocument(endpoints: readonly Endpoint[], registry: z.core.$ZodRegistry<{ id: string }>)` (use the registry type that z.registry<{ id: string }>() returns): components = z.toJSONSchema(registry, { io: 'input', uri: (id) => `#/components/schemas/${id}` }).schemas with $schema/$id removed from each; schemaRef(schema, operationId): registry.get(schema)?.id -> { $ref }, z.ZodArray whose .element is registered -> { type: 'array', items: { $ref } }, else throw new Error(`Register the API schemas of ${operationId}.`); parameters from params.shape (in 'path', required true) and query.shape (in 'query', required !field.isOptional()), each { name, in, required, description: field.description, schema: stripped z.toJSONSchema(field, { io: 'input' }) }; requestBody { required: true, content: { 'application/json': { schema } } }; responses: success (content unless 204), 400 when body or query ('The request is invalid; `issues` lists each problem.'), 401 always ('The API key is missing, malformed or revoked.'), 404 when params ("The tournament, or something else in the path, doesn't exist in the key's organization."), 409 ("The tournament's current phase or state doesn't allow this.") / 422 ('The request breaks a rule of the tournament.') from conflicts; all error responses `{ description, content: { 'application/json': { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' } } } }`. Document: { openapi: '3.1.0', info: { title: 'Tournament Manager API', version: '1.0.0', description: short text on org-scoped keys and JSON }, servers: [{ url: '/api/v1' }], security: [{ apiKey: [] }], tags: TAGS, paths, components: { securitySchemes: { apiKey: { type: 'http', scheme: 'bearer', description: 'An organization API key, `tm_<prefix>_<secret>`. Create one in the organization admin, on the API keys tab.' } }, schemas } }. Export `type OpenApiDocument = ReturnType<typeof buildOpenApiDocument>` (give the function an explicit, readable return interface using z.core.JSONSchema.JSONSchema for schema objects so reference.ts can type against it).

New src/lib/server/api/schemas.ts: `/** Named schemas of the REST API; they become `components.schemas` of the OpenAPI document. */ export const components = z.registry<{ id: string }>();` then `errorSchema.register(components, { id: 'Error' })`. Define and register (`.describe('…').register(components, { id })`) exactly the schemas of plan.md item 9 with these names/ids: createTournamentBody (TournamentCreate) = tournamentSchema.pick({ name: true, slug: true }); updateTournamentBody (TournamentUpdate) = tournamentSchema.extend({ startsAt: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }).transform((value) => new Date(value)).nullable() }).partial(); themeBody (ThemeUpdate); requirementResource (Requirement); requirementsBody (RequirementsUpdate); stageSettingsSchema (StageSettings) and stageConfigSchema (StageConfig) from #lib/tournaments.ts registered as-is; structureBody (StructureUpdate) = z.object({ stages: structureSchema }); addParticipantBody (ParticipantAdd); seedsBody (SeedOrder); checkInBody (CheckInUpdate); scoresTuple (Scores) = z.tuple([score, score]) with score = z.int('Scores must be whole numbers, zero or more.').min(0, same).max(999_999_999, same); resultBody (ResultUpdate); reportBody (ReportCreate); messageBody (MessageCreate) = z.object({ body: messageSchema }); responses tournamentResource (Tournament), tournamentSummaryResource (TournamentSummary), stageResource (Stage), requirementCheckResource (RequirementCheck), participantResource (Participant), matchResource (Match), matchDetailResource (MatchDetail = matchResource.extend({ decidedBy })), reportOutcomeResource (ReportOutcome), messageResource (Message). Use z.uuid() for ids, z.iso.datetime() for dates, z.enum(tournamentStatus.enumValues / stageType.enumValues / stageStatus.enumValues) from #lib/server/db/schema.ts, a local `MATCH_STATUSES = ['waiting', 'ready', 'reported', 'disputed', 'completed', 'bye', 'skipped'] as const satisfies readonly MatchProgress[]`. Params (not registered): tournamentParams, participantParams, matchParams (matchIdSchema.describe('The match id.')) and matchQuery { stage: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).optional().describe('Only matches of this stage: 0 is the first.'), status: z.enum(MATCH_STATUSES).optional().describe('Only matches with this status.') }.

New src/lib/server/api/responses.ts: `toTournament(row: Tournament): z.input<typeof tournamentResource>`, `toSummary(row)` (the listOrgTournaments row), `toStages(bracket: Bracket)` (id, index, type, status, settings, groups: group.entrants as participantIds + group.standings), `async toParticipants(tournamentId)` (listParticipants + checkRequirements; requirements: { moduleId, moduleName, status, ...(status === 'ineligible' && { reason }) }), `toMatch(item: MatchItem)` (status = item.progress, entrants = [item.entrants[0] ?? null, item.entrants[1] ?? null], result = item.result && { scores: item.result.scores ?? null, winnerId: item.result.winner === null ? null : item.result.entrants[item.result.winner] }, reports = item.reports.map(r => ({ participantId: item.entrants[r.side]!, scores: r.scores }))), `toMatchDetail(detail: NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getMatch>>>)` (toMatch + decidedBy), `toMessage(message: ChatMessage)` (createdAt ISO, author { username, displayName } | null, apiKey). Dates via toISOString().

New src/lib/server/api/handler.ts: `type Input<E, K extends 'params' | 'query' | 'body'> = E extends { [P in K]: infer S extends z.ZodType } ? z.output<S> : undefined;` `type Result<E extends Endpoint> = E['response'] extends { schema: infer S extends z.ZodType } ? z.input<S> : void;` `export interface ApiContext<E extends Endpoint> { event: RequestEvent; key: ApiKeyAccess; params: Input<E, 'params'>; query: Input<E, 'query'>; body: Input<E, 'body'> }` (this typing compiled in planning). `/** Wraps an endpoint's handler: checks the API key, validates the request with the definition's schemas and answers errors with the envelope. */ export function endpoint<E extends Endpoint>(definition: E, run: (context: ApiContext<E>) => Promise<Result<E>>)`: handler = async (event) => { try { key = await requireApiKey(event); params = definition.params?.safeParse(event.params); if (params && !params.success) error(404, params.error.issues[0].message); query = definition.query?.parse(Object.fromEntries(event.url.searchParams)); body = definition.body ? definition.body.parse(await readJson(event.request)) : undefined; result = await run({ event, key, params: params?.data, query, body } as ApiContext<E>); return 'schema' in definition.response ? json(result, { status: definition.response.status }) : new Response(null, { status: 204 }); } catch (e) { return errorResponse(e); } }; `return Object.assign(handler satisfies RequestHandler, { endpoint: definition });`. readJson: try `await request.json()` catch -> error(400, 'The request body must be JSON.'). `export const methodNotAllowed: RequestHandler = () => apiError(405, 'This method is not allowed here.');`.

New src/lib/server/api/endpoints.ts: 29 `export const <operationId> = defineEndpoint({ … })` in the plan.md table order, each with tag, summary, description where behavior needs explaining (addParticipant: like the Participants tab it skips requirements and the participant limit, `requirements` shows how the user measures up; deleteTournament: drafts only; open-registration publishes a draft or reopens registration during check-in; open-check-in closes sign-ups; unpublish only without participants; start leaves out participants who didn't check in; start-next-stage once the group stage is done; setStages same rules as the structure editor, locked once started; setSeeds lists every participant once; listMatches byes are left out, `status` is what players see; setMatchResult sets or corrects the result as an organizer, replacing the reports and clearing disputes and help requests, stored as decided by the API key; reportMatch reports for one player, matching reports from both decide the match, different ones dispute it; postMessage shows as an organizer message labelled with the key's name), params/query/body/response schemas from schemas.ts and conflicts per the table. Then `/** Every REST endpoint, in documentation order. */ export const endpoints = [ … ] as const;` and `/** The OpenAPI document, built from the same definitions the routes validate with. */ export const openApiDocument = buildOpenApiDocument(endpoints, components);`.

Route files under src/routes/api/v1/ (listed in plan.md Digest). Pattern: `import { endpoint, methodNotAllowed } from '#lib/server/api/handler.ts'; import * as api from '#lib/server/api/endpoints.ts'; import { toTournament } from '#lib/server/api/responses.ts'; import { requireApiTournament } from '#lib/server/auth/apiKey.ts'; …services…` then e.g. `export const GET = endpoint(api.getTournament, async ({ key, params }) => toTournament(await requireApiTournament(key, params.tournamentId)));` and always `export const fallback = methodNotAllowed;`. Specifics: tournaments/+server.ts GET toSummary over listOrgTournaments(key.orgId, { includeDrafts: true }), POST toTournament(await createTournament(key.orgId, body)); [tournamentId]/+server.ts PATCH `updateTournament(t, { name: t.name, slug: t.slug, description: t.description, startsAt: t.startsAt, participantLimit: t.participantLimit, ...body })`, DELETE deleteDraftTournament(t); theme PUT setTheme then toTournament(reloaded); requirements GET getRequirements, PUT `const parsed = parseRequirements(body.requirements, listModules()); if (!parsed.ok) throw new ServiceError(parsed.error, 'invalid'); await setRequirements(t, parsed.requirements); return getRequirements(t.id);`; open-registration/open-check-in/unpublish -> setStatus(t, 'registration' | 'check_in' | 'draft'), start -> startTournament(t), start-next-stage -> startNextStage(t), each returning toTournament((await getTournamentById(t.id))!); stages GET toStages(await getBracket(t.id)), PUT setStructure(t, body.stages) then the same; participants GET toParticipants(t.id), POST `const id = await addParticipant(t, body.username); return (await toParticipants(t.id)).find((p) => p.id === id)!;`; participants/seeds PUT setSeeds then list; participants/shuffle POST shuffleSeeds then list; participants/[participantId] DELETE removeParticipant; participants/[participantId]/check-in PUT setCheckedIn(t, params.participantId, body.checkedIn) then find; matches GET listMatches(await getBracket(t.id)) filtered by query.stage (stageIndex) and query.status (progress) mapped with toMatch; matches/[matchId] GET getMatch -> error(404, 'Match not found.') if undefined; result PUT setMatchResult(t, params.matchId, body.scores, { apiKeyId: key.id }) then toMatchDetail((await getMatch(t.id, params.matchId))!), DELETE clearMatchResult then the same; reports POST `const outcome = await reportForParticipant(t, params.matchId, { participantId: body.participantId, apiKeyId: key.id }, body.scores); return { outcome, match: toMatchDetail(…) };`; help DELETE clearHelp then detail; messages GET (getMatch -> 404, then listMessages(params.matchId).map(toMessage)), POST toMessage(await postMessage(t, params.matchId, { apiKeyName: key.name }, body.body)). Plus src/routes/api/v1/openapi.json/+server.ts (`/** The OpenAPI document. Public, so tools can fetch it without a key. */ export const GET: RequestHandler = () => json(openApiDocument); export const fallback = methodNotAllowed;`) and src/routes/api/v1/[...path]/+server.ts (`/** Unknown API routes answer with the error envelope, not the HTML error page. */ export const fallback: RequestHandler = () => apiError(404, 'There is no such endpoint.');`).

New src/lib/server/api/handler.db.spec.ts (db project): resetDatabase, an org and key via createApiKey; a test-local `defineEndpoint({ operationId: 'test', method: 'POST', path: '/things/{thingId}', tag: 'Tournaments', summary: 'x', params: z.object({ thingId: z.uuid('Thing not found.') }), query: z.object({ n: z.coerce.number().int().optional() }), body: z.object({ name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required.') }), response: { status: 201, description: 'x', schema: z.object({ name: z.string() }) } })` wrapped with endpoint() whose run returns the body or throws a ServiceError when name === 'conflict'; a fake event helper `(init) => ({ request: new Request('http://localhost/api/v1/things/…', init), params: { thingId }, url } as unknown as RequestEvent)`. Assert: no Authorization -> 401 unauthorized + www-authenticate; bad thingId -> 404 'Thing not found.'; body '{nope' -> 400; `{ name: '' }` -> 400 issues [{ path: ['name'], message: 'Name is required.' }]; name 'conflict' -> 409; valid -> 201 JSON; a 204 definition -> status 204 and empty text; methodNotAllowed() -> 405 method_not_allowed.

New src/lib/server/api/openapi.db.spec.ts (db project because it imports endpoints and route modules): document checks (openapi '3.1.0', servers[0].url '/api/v1', components.securitySchemes.apiKey { type: 'http', scheme: 'bearer' }, security [{ apiKey: [] }], components.schemas.Error present); every endpoint at paths[path][method.toLowerCase()] with its operationId, operationIds unique, tags[0] listed in document tags, each `{param}` in the path has a required path parameter; recursive walk: every $ref starts with '#/components/schemas/' and names an existing schema, and no component keeps $schema or $id; route coverage via `import.meta.glob<Record<string, unknown>>('/src/routes/api/v1/**/+server.ts', { eager: true })`: skip openapi.json and [...path]; path = file.replace('/src/routes/api/v1', '').replace('/+server.ts', '').replace(/\[(\w+)\]/g, '{$1}'); for each of GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE exported, `(mod[method] as { endpoint?: Endpoint }).endpoint` exists with that method and path and is in `endpoints`; every file exports fallback; the collected set has the same size (29) as `endpoints` and contains all of them.
Run corepack pnpm format, then check, lint and the unit/db tests; fix anything they report.
acceptance_criteria: `corepack pnpm check` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings
`corepack pnpm test:unit --run src/lib/server/api` passes errors.spec.ts, handler.db.spec.ts and openapi.db.spec.ts
`corepack pnpm test:unit --run` passes everything (FEAT-001 total plus the new API tests)

Every src/routes/api/v1/**/+server.ts except openapi.json and [...path] exports only endpoint()-wrapped handlers plus fallback, and openapi.db.spec.ts proves the 29 endpoints and the routes match one-to-one
No route handler contains business rules: each calls services and serializers only (the parseRequirements check and the 404 for a missing match are the only inline throws)
verification: corepack pnpm format; corepack pnpm lint
findings: Done as specified; no schema change, no migration, no new dependencies. New: src/lib/server/api/{errors.ts, errors.spec.ts, openapi.ts, schemas.ts, responses.ts, handler.ts, endpoints.ts, handler.db.spec.ts, openapi.db.spec.ts} and 23 route files under src/routes/api/v1 (21 endpoint routes + openapi.json + [...path]). The generated document has 21 paths, 29 operations and 25 component schemas (Error, StageSettings, StageConfig, TournamentCreate, TournamentUpdate, ThemeUpdate, Requirement, RequirementsUpdate, StructureUpdate, ParticipantAdd, SeedOrder, CheckInUpdate, Scores, ResultUpdate, ReportCreate, MessageCreate, Tournament, TournamentSummary, Stage, RequirementCheck, Participant, Match, MatchDetail, ReportOutcome, Message). One deviation: instead of `toMatchDetail((await getMatch(...))!)` in each match route, responses.ts has `matchDetail(tournamentId, matchId)`, which calls getMatch and throws error(404, 'Match not found.') when it's undefined (byes aren't listed, so a bye id would otherwise crash with a 500). getMatch, result PUT/DELETE, reports and help use it. The only other inline throws are the setRequirements ServiceError(parsed.error, 'invalid') and the listMessages 404. openapi.ts exports `interface OpenApiDocument` (plus OpenApiOperation, OpenApiParameter, OpenApiResponse) as the builder's explicit return type, `TAGS`, `Tag`, `Method`, `Endpoint`, `defineEndpoint`. Its error responses ref the registered errorSchema, so the builder throws if Error isn't registered. errors.ts exports ERROR_CODES, errorSchema, apiError and errorResponse; statuses outside ERROR_CODES map to 400/500 in both status and code. ApiContext params/query/body are fully typed in the routes. Verification: format clean; check 0 errors/0 warnings; lint clean (prettier + eslint); test:unit --run src/lib/server/api: 3 files / 16 tests (errors.spec 6, handler.db.spec 6, openapi.db.spec 4); test:unit --run: 28 files / 319 tests pass (FEAT-001's 303 + 16).
